original_text: Curcumin did not significantly alter oral midazolam AUC or Cmax in healthy human volunteers.
Goldenseal decreased renal clearance of metformin via OCT and MATE transporter inhibition in humans.
Mitragynine inhibits CYP3A4 mediated clearance increasing opioid exposure and toxicity risk in human volunteers.
Goldenseal administration resulted in a 40 percent decrease in midazolam oral clearance due to CYP3A inhibition.
Curcumin increased the oral bioavailability and peak concentration of P-gp substrate talinolol.
